rows: Summary: KRGC Gwalior is an NAAC ‘A’ accredited autonomous women’s institution under Jiwaji University. The DHE, Madhya Pradesh, oversees the college's centralized merit-based admissions process, which offers 63 undergraduate and postgraduate programs in the arts, sciences, commerce, and home sciences. The college has knowledgeable instructors, adequate amenities, and an academically oriented campus life with a few cultural and NSS/NCC events. Hostel and lodging facilities need improvement, and placement opportunities are available but scarce, averaging approximately INR 4.8 LPA. All things considered, KRGC provides high-quality, affordable education with positive student reviews. Direct Link to Official Website: KRGC Gwalior

rows: The Vignana Jyothi Institute of Management interview focuses on your true personality, not just marks. From discussions on Quora User, below is a simple overview of his Interview experience: Know yourself: Be ready to answer ‘Tell me about yourself’ in 1 to 2 minutes (include family, education, goals, hobbies, and why MBA). Why Vignana Jyothi Institute of Management and why MBA? Explain honestly how the institute fits your career dreams and what you like about its programs (like innovation focus or specializations). Current affairs & business news: Read newspapers daily for new topics (e.g., elections, startups, economy issues like Byju's or Zomato changes). Your resume: Talk about academics, work experience (if any), projects, strengths/weaknesses, role models, and extracurriculars with real examples. PI tips: Stay confident, smile, make eye contact, dress neatly, and be honest, if you don't know something, say so calmly.

admission.heading: Vidya Academy of Science & Technology (VAST) B.Tech Admission
rows: Candidates should have passed senior secondary school from Kerala or any other equivalent examination with an average minimum of 50% marks in Mathematics and 50% marks in the aggregate of subjects such as Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry OR If candidates have passed Higher Secondary Examination, Kerala, or any other examination holding equivalent value with an average minimum of 45% marks in subjects Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry can apply for admissions through the Management Quota. OR If candidates have not studied Chemistry, candidates can produce a grade card for Computer Science as a subject in the qualifying examination. OR If candidates have not studied Chemistry and Computer Science, candidates can produce a grade card for Biotechnology as subject in the qualifying examination OR If candidates have not studied Chemistry, Computer Science and Biotechnology, candidates can produce a grade card for Biology as subject in the qualifying examination Candidates’ marks scored in the Board of Examination from any recognized Board will also be considered for the evaluation process. For NRI candidates, they do not have to appear for the entrance examination and should provide the below-mentioned documents at the admission time: (a) NRI/Dependence/Sponsorship certificate (Format –Download) (b) Copy of VISA of the sponsor (c) Copy of Passport of the sponsor
Candidates should have qualified and secured a rank in the KEAM.

admission.heading: Vidya Academy of Science & Technology (VAST) B.Tech Lateral Entry Admission
rows: Candidates who hold a Diploma Certificate in Engineering issued by the State Board of Technical Education or Equivalent after studying the course for a duration of 3 years from a reputed institute can apply. If candidates have completed graduation with subjects such as Maths/Physics as compulsory subjects and hold Diplom Certificate in Engineering branch can also apply as per the AICTE guidelines
Rank secured in the Lateral Entry Test (LET)

admission.heading: Vidya Academy of Science & Technology (VAST) M.Tech Admission
rows: Candidates should be an Indian national. Those who have completed their graduation in an AICTE recognized institute or Deemed Universities can also apply. Candidates should have secured an average minimum of 60% marks (54% marks for candidates belonging to the reserved categories) in the Engineering programme examination. Those who have qualified AMIE / AMIETE Examinations and also fulfill the above-mentioned criteria can also apply. They should have a valid GATE score and a 55% marks scored in section B in AMIE/AMIETE examination.

admission.heading: Vidya Academy of Science & Technology (VAST) M.C.A. Admission
rows: Candidates should hold a Bachelor’s degree in any stream where the course duration should be of a minimum of 3 years with Mathematics as the main subject in senior secondary school or during under graduation. Candidates should have secured an average minimum of 50% marks (45% for the candidates belonging to the reserved candidates in the examination. OR Those who hold a B.Com Degree with subjects such as Business Mathematics or Business Statistics can also apply.
Candidates should have qualified and secured a rank in the MCA Entrance Exam of Kerala.

admission.heading: DOMS IIT Kanpur MBA Admission 2026
rows: Students can find real candidate's GD and PI experience for IIT Kanpur MBA (from a 2025 admission session, shared by an engineering fresher): Profile — B.Tech graduate (fresher), decent CAT score. GD — Peaceful and well-organized. Topic was something current like economy or policy (e.g., similar to past ones on retirement age). Everyone got 45 seconds to speak first, then 6-7 minutes open discussion. No chaos & people were polite, volunteers helped a lot. The candidate felt it went smoothly. PI — Panel of 2 professors (friendly vibe overall). Lasted 15-20 minutes.Started with "Tell me about yourself" and "Why MBA after B.Tech?" answered confidently.Few basic questions on academics/background. One professor asked light questions, smiled at small jokes, mostly observed. No heavy grilling. Overall feel — Very good process, great people, beautiful campus. GD-PI carries high weight (around 40%). Stay honest, confident, and prepare your "Why MBA" well. Many candidates loved the experience.

admission.heading: Application Process
rows: - Fill out the online form on the official IBMR Gurgaon website. - Form requires personal, academic, and entrance exam details.

- Educational certificates (10th, 12th, Graduation mark sheets). - Entrance exam scorecard. - Passport-sized photos. - Valid ID proof (Aadhar, Passport, etc.). - Work experience certificate (if applicable).
- A nominal fee is required, payable online.
- Candidates are shortlisted based on entrance exam scores (CAT, MAT, XAT, etc.) or IBMR’s internal test. - Those who meet eligibility and cut-offs are invited to the next round.
- Evaluates motivation, career goals, knowledge, and program suitability. - Conducted by a panel of professors or industry experts.
- Based on composite score (entrance exam score, GD/PI performance, academic performance, and work experience).
- Selected candidates receive an offer of admission. - To confirm admission, candidates must pay the admission fee by the given deadline.

admission.heading: VVISM Hyderabad PGDM Admission Process 2026
rows: PGDM is a flagship, industry-focused postgraduate diploma approved by AICTE. Candidates can choose from available specializations based on career interests such as Marketing, Finance, HR, Business Analytics, or Operations.

Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university with at least 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories, if applicable). Final-year graduation students may also apply, subject to completion before admission confirmation.

PGDM applicants must have a valid score in national or state-level management entrance exams such as CAT, XAT, MAT, ATMA, CMAT, GMAT, TS ICET, or other exams accepted by VVISM. Entrance exam performance is a critical shortlisting criterion.

Candidates must apply through the VVISM admissions portal by creating an account, verifying their email ID, filling in personal, academic, and entrance exam details, uploading required documents, paying the application fee, and submitting the form before the deadline. Offline application options may also be available.

Shortlisted PGDM candidates are invited for Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds. These assess communication skills, leadership qualities, analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, industry awareness, and career orientation.
Final selection is based on a composite score including entrance exam marks, academic record, GD/PI performance, work experience (if any), and overall profile suitability for the PGDM program.

Selected candidates receive an official offer letter. To confirm the seat, candidates must pay the first installment of the program fee and submit original documents for verification within the stipulated timeline.

Students receive admission confirmation and reporting instructions. The institute announces orientation schedules, academic calendars, and class commencement dates. Students must report to campus as per instructions to begin the program.
